name: design-skills
description: Design skills by UV: critique, page intros, working docs, design guardrails, audits, performance and Framer agent templates, for Claude Code.

plugins.name: all-design-skills
plugins.description: Every design skill by UV in one install: openfile-principle, cursor-build-intro, working-docs, design-guardrails, design-system-audit, perf-pass, framer-agent-template. MIT.

plugins.name: openfile-principle
plugins.description: Critique a UI screenshot, site, Figma frame or code through 16 design principles: what's clearly off, why it matters, one question and one experiment for the next version. By UV. MIT.

plugins.name: cursor-build-intro
plugins.description: A page intro where labelled multiplayer cursors draw the page as frames with live W x H badges, then hand over to the real page. One dependency-free React component. By UV. MIT.

plugins.name: working-docs
plugins.description: Set up and keep AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md and CONTEXT.md, the working docs that let coding agents build a design project the way its designer would, and remember decisions between sessions. By UV. MIT.

plugins.name: design-guardrails
plugins.description: Turn a project's design rules into checks that fail the build or the verify run: tokens only, banned copy, real alt text, contrast, one h1, no overflow, a visible focus ring on every Tab stop. By UV. MIT.

plugins.name: design-system-audit
plugins.description: Audit a running product against its design system with measured evidence, rank P0 and P1, fix the root cause as a system change, then sweep the code with a property-scoped mapping. By UV. MIT.

plugins.name: perf-pass
plugins.description: Make a design-heavy site load fast and scroll smoothly on an ordinary phone: a budget, a measured before and after, a cause for every symptom, and rules that keep it fast. By UV. MIT.

plugins.name: framer-agent-template
plugins.description: Turn a Framer template into a Framer Marketplace Agent Template: styles, layer names, a /design-system page, agent skills, a demo video and the Marketplace form. By UV. MIT.
